    let _ = c.kill();
}

fn b() {
    let alive = id.is_alive();
}

// libc::kill(p, 9) and Command::new("taskkill")
fn c() {
    let s = "TerminateProcess(h, 1) taskkill";
    paddock_proc::kill_tree(id);
    paddock_proc::end(id);
}

fn d(p: i32) {
    unsafe { libc::kill(p, 9) };
    if let Some(p) = sys.process(id) { p.kill(); }
}
